profile.name: Rekha Mecherry
profile.title: Cloud Architect & Platform Engineer
profile.about: Accomplished Technical Leader and Enterprise & Cloud Solutions Architect with 20+ years of experience across Financial, Telecom, and Insurance domains. Proven expertise in platform engineering, enterprise architecture, web & microservices architecture and enterprise integration, designing and delivering cloud native solutions, IaC & DevOps, API Management, event driven messaging & streaming platforms and Conversational AI solutions. Currently leading platform engineering and AI automation initiatives for highly regulated environment, combining hands on technical leadership with strategic vision to deliver compliant, enterprise solutions, while improving developer experience and cloud adoption.

certifications: Google Cloud Certified - Cloud Digital Leader

experience.role: [VP] Lead Software Engineer - Cloud / Platform Engineering

career_highlights.title: Project Excellence Award
career_highlights.detail: Awarded by Infosys for the implementation of a humanoid voice system — a cutting-edge Conversational AI solution for a major US telecom client.

career_highlights.title: Azure IoT Platform Security
career_highlights.detail: Secured the Azure cloud platform for an IoT product; received formal appreciation from leadership for outstanding contributions to the account.

career_highlights.title: Star of the Month & Team of the Quarter
career_highlights.detail: Recognised multiple times with Star of the Month and Team of the Quarter awards for exceptional individual and team performance.

career_highlights.title: 6-Year Offshore Product Leadership
career_highlights.detail: Successfully led offshore product development for Health & Benefit LOB projects over 6 years, earning accolades from senior onshore leaders.

career_timeline.role: [VP] Lead Platform Engineer - Cloud / Platform Engineering

work_experience.title: Lead Platform Engineer
work_experience.subtitle: Lead - Platform Engineering & Automations
points: Leading a platform engineering initiative to build the foundation layer for cloud-native service enablement, onboarding Microsoft Fabric SaaS via an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) with self-service automation.
Designed and implemented an extendable foundation architecture that accelerates enterprise cloud modernization by delivering secure, compliant, and reusable automation workflows.
Integrated technologies including Python, FastAPI, Kafka, GitHub Actions CI, Harness CD, and OpenShift to enable scalable and consistent adoption of Fabric services across environments.

work_experience.title: Lead Cloud Platform Engineer
work_experience.subtitle: Lead Software Engineer
points: Developed native GCP services and middleware modules with embedded centralised logging, monitoring, and enterprise policies aligned to Cloud Control Framework and industry security benchmarks.
Validated and designed IAM access permissions for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) modules, enforcing standardised access controls and governance for secure automation.
Extended platform modules using the Terraform test framework, implementing unit and integration testing to improve reliability and compliance.
Leading the enablement of self-service provisioning for cloud-native services through an Internal Developer Portal (IDP), driving secure, consistent, and scalable platform adoption.
Leveraged GitHub Copilot for coding, testing, and documentation; actively involved in cloud service activation processes aligned to enterprise procedures.

work_experience.title: Enterprise Architect - Sr.System Architect
work_experience.subtitle: Enterprise Architecture
points: Designed and delivered Business, Application, and Technology architectures using ArchiMate and BizzDesign Enterprise Studio.
Contributed to application portfolio rationalisation, cloud migration assessments, and definition of target-state architectures to support enterprise modernisation initiatives.
Ensured alignment of business capabilities with technology roadmaps; participated in vendor architecture reviews and security assessments to maintain compliance with enterprise standards.

work_experience.title: PaaS/IaaS & DevOps Architect / Consultant
work_experience.subtitle: IoT Platform & Innovation Projects
points: Designed and delivered Azure Serverless Architecture for an enterprise IoT platform — Azure Functions, APIM Gateway, Event Hub, Azure Storage, and VNet-secured APIM policies.
Implemented Traffic Manager, Azure Front Door, and Application Gateway for global load balancing and high availability.
Designed DR and BCP for serverless workloads with multi-region failover, custom APIM policies, and cross-region replication for Azure PostgreSQL supporting analytics and disaster recovery.
Built a Blue-Green deployment CI/CD pipeline for Azure Functions using GitHub Actions, Bicep, and ARM templates, ensuring zero-downtime releases.
Architected a humanoid mobile application with a custom speech engine using Google Dialogflow, Android, and NLP for a major US telecom client — enhancing retail customer engagement.
Built retail experiences using Amazon Alexa, designing an In-Store Assistant for Amazon Echo Show.

Contributed to a telecom pilot implementing Face Biometrics Authentication on edge devices using CoreML, Google ML Kit, and TensorFlow Lite for real-time identity verification in low-latency environments.

work_experience.title: Product Architect & API Gateway Administrator
work_experience.subtitle: Web Application Product
points: Managed IBM API Gateway (API Connect) for a suite of identity & credit protection products used across Canadian financial institutions, ensuring secure access and compliance.
Led modernisation initiatives converting legacy web services into microservices, supporting cloud migration to scalable, cloud-native architectures.
Delivered OpenAPI-driven architectures standardising API governance, documentation, versioning, and developer onboarding.

projects.name: Automated Self-Service Infrastructure Provisioning Engine (IDP)
projects.role: Lead Infrastructure Engineer [VP] - Cloud Platform Engineering
projects.description: Architecting and leading an automated self-service infrastructure provisioning engine within an Internal Developer Portal (IDP), leveraging a Python + FastAPI backend integration framework to orchestrate, validate, and execute cloud service provisioning. Enables business teams with secure self-service capabilities, driving 65% time savings, accelerating cloud adoption, and improving developer velocity.
projects.highlights: Drives 65% time savings in cloud service provisioning, improves developer velocity, and accelerates cloud adoption in a highly regulated financial enterprise.

projects.name: Agentic AI Multi-Agent Orchestrator for Dynamic Cloud Provisioning
projects.role: Lead Infrastructure Engineer [VP] - Cloud Platform Engineering
projects.description: Prototyping and designing an Agentic AI multi-agent orchestrator leveraging Azure AI Foundry to automate dynamic provisioning of cloud services. Focuses on enabling intelligent orchestration and adaptive workflows using Agentic AI, aimed at improving automation efficiency and enterprise scalability.
projects.highlights: Pioneered agentic AI workflow orchestration for cloud service automation and intelligent infrastructure decisioning.

projects.name: Enterprise Cloud-Native Infrastructure & GKE Automation
projects.role: Lead Infrastructure Engineer [VP] - Cloud Platform Engineering
projects.description: Engineered and provisioned secure core cloud-native services using HashiCorp Terraform, Sentinel, and Vault modules to support large-scale financial application workloads. Implemented Archetype Template configurations and established fine-grained IAM access permissions for Terraform service accounts, enabling automated and secure deployments of Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) services.
projects.highlights: Established automated, secure, and compliant deployments of GKE modules aligned to Cloud Control Framework and industry security benchmarks.

projects.name: Enterprise Architecture Modeling & Application Rationalization
projects.description: Contributed to domain-specific business application rationalization initiatives by defining, designing, and modeling current and future-state technology roadmaps using Open Group ArchiMate and BizzDesign Enterprise Studio. Accelerated enterprise cloud modernization strategies by collaborating with business teams on application cloud migrations, third-party vendor onboarding, and executing comprehensive security assessments.
projects.highlights: Streamlined application portfolios, reduced redundant systems, and aligned enterprise architecture roadmaps with BIAN and TOGAF standards.

projects.name: Azure Serverless IoT Platform & Resilient PaaS Architecture
projects.description: Designed Azure APIM security enhancements for an IoT platform product in Azure PaaS/IaaS, securing connectivity via Azure APIM gateways integrated with dedicated Virtual Networks (VNets) and custom policy restrictions. Maximized system availability and resilience by designing a robust disaster recovery strategy, implementing custom cross-region failover policies in Azure APIM, and configuring cross-region replicas for Azure PostgreSQL. Eliminated deployment downtime by introducing Blue-Green deployment strategies into CI/CD pipelines via Bicep and ARM templates for serverless Azure Functions.
projects.highlights: Secured the Azure cloud platform for an IoT product; received leadership appreciation; achieved zero-downtime Blue-Green releases and multi-region disaster recovery.

projects.name: Humanoid Temi Robot Conversational Retail Assistant
projects.description: Conceptualized and built an autonomous humanoid Temi Robot retail application leveraging a custom speech framework via Google Dialogflow on Android. Designed custom dialogue management and NLP interfaces for low-latency in-store customer engagement for a major US telecom client.
projects.highlights: Winner of the prestigious Infosys Project Excellence Award for pioneering Conversational AI in retail robotics.

projects.name: Omni-Channel Retail In-Store Voice Assistant (Amazon Echo Show)
projects.description: Designed an omni-channel retail in-store conversational assistant for Amazon Echo Show using the Alexa SDK, Alexa Presentation Framework (APL), and AWS Cloud Services (Lambda, IAM, S3, DynamoDB) to deliver interactive multimodal shopping experiences.
projects.highlights: Delivered voice-first interactive retail experiences across smart display hardware.

projects.name: IBM API Gateway Administration & Canadian FinTech Modernization
projects.description: Governed IBM API Connect gateway platform administration for a suite of value-added identity and credit protection products serving Canadian financial institutions. Led the modernization of legacy monolithic web services into secure, OpenAPI-compliant .NET microservices optimized for seamless cloud integration and third-party data exchange. Enforced robust application-level security architectures by integrating OAuth 2.0 via Identity Server alongside automated unit testing frameworks.
projects.highlights: Modernized legacy monoliths to cloud-native microservices; enforced bank-grade API governance and security across leading Canadian financial institutions.

projects.name: Global Benefit Suite Portal & Healthcare LOB Ecosystem
projects.description: Supervised offshore product development, architecture definition, requirement analysis, and engineering execution for critical global healthcare systems and employee benefits lines of business (LOB) over 6 years. Architected and deployed the Global Benefit Suite Portal, creating an integrated e-business healthcare ecosystem spanning Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. Built high-throughput distributed architectures using WCF, complex stored procedures and ETL integration pipelines using SQL Server, SSIS, and SSRS, and analytical business dashboards.
projects.highlights: Successfully led offshore product development for Health & Benefit LOB projects over 6 years, earning accolades from senior onshore leaders.

projects.name: Distributed Backend Architecture & Systems Integration
projects.description: Designed and implemented core distributed backend architectures using Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) technology to support secure, high-throughput integration across distributed security and access management applications.
projects.highlights: Engineered reliable, high-throughput distributed integration services for physical security and enterprise systems.

projects.name: Multi-Tier Enterprise Web Applications & Core Services
projects.description: Engineered robust multi-tier web applications utilizing HTML, JavaScript, ASP/ASP.NET, and SQL Server. Constructed core Web Services to facilitate seamless integration and maintained backend transactional data logic using SQL Server and stored procedures.
projects.highlights: Constructed foundational multi-tier e-business solutions and database transaction pipelines.
